about: Shot list, script v2 (the reviewer's rewrite, adopted 3 Nov). Times from a calm read at 2.5 words a second, to be settled by the read-through; shots-v1.json is the first cut's.

shots.action: A painted beach at dawn; a fingertip lifts a little sand; Grain, one grain among them, peers up with its head tilted.
shots.board: tiny sand grain glowing in blackness as camera pushes in
shots.caption: Big things can begin very small. How small?

shots.action: Grain's questioning look held against a quiet sky, then the title.
labels: How silicon becomes the heart of our electronics
shots.board: grain fills screen revealing lattice and title From Sand to Chip
shots.caption: Small enough to slip between your fingers.

shots.action: From the beach to an ochre quarry with broad terraces; a selected quartz rock is lifted onto a conveyor, Grain riding on it.
shots.board: wide quarry at dawn with excavator loading white rock
shots.caption: Many grains of sand contain quartz. Our factory journey starts with carefully selected quartz rock.

shots.action: On the conveyor Grain peers at the rock; a magnifying circle opens over it.
shots.board: truck dumps rock into crusher feeding gravel conveyor
shots.caption: What's inside it?

shots.action: Inside the circle a simplified silicon-and-oxygen arrangement; the oxygen twins hold Grain's hands as the cartoon of the bond.
shots.board: pebble bursts into SiO2 diagram with one silicon and two oxygens
shots.caption: Silicon and oxygen, chemically joined.

shots.action: The furnace in charcoal, burnt orange and cream; the quartz goes in with carbon; Grain tumbles in with its twins and lands; the carbon characters wait.
shots.board: gravel tipping into blazing arc furnace mouth
shots.caption: In a fiercely hot furnace, carbon helps remove the oxygen.

shots.action: The carbon characters lead the oxygen twins away as departing wisps of gas; Grain, now grey silicon, calls after them.
shots.board: atoms split as black carbons steal red oxygens from grey silicon
shots.caption: There go my travelling companions!

shots.action: Grain in its grey silicon form looks itself over and notices flecks of unwanted material on its body.
shots.board: grey silicon stream cooling into dull lump
shots.caption: What remains is silicon, but it still needs cleaning.

shots.action: Pale violet, warm white and steel blue: Grain turns into its wisp form, the silicon-containing chemical, rising into a distillation column.
shots.board: grey lump melting into swirling gas in glass column
shots.caption: First, silicon is converted into a chemical that can be purified by distillation.

shots.action: The wisp rises through the column, the dark flecks left behind on the plates.
shots.board: gas rising through filters shedding specks as counter climbs
shots.caption: Leave the unwanted bits behind.

shots.action: Glowing heated rods in a chamber visibly thicken as pure silicon deposits on them; Grain's face settles onto one rod.
shots.board: pure gas freezing into solid rods beside purity counter
shots.caption: Then a reaction deposits very pure silicon onto heated rods.

shots.action: Chunks of the rods melt in a glowing crucible.
shots.board: seed rod dipping into glowing silicon melt
shots.caption: The purified silicon is melted.

shots.action: A small seed on a rod touches the melt, then rises and turns slowly; the crystal starts to grow from the contact.
shots.board: seed rising and spinning pulling crystal column upward
shots.caption: A tiny seed crystal touches the surface, then slowly rises and turns.

shots.action: A magnifying circle at the growth front: atoms joining in neat rows; then back to the chamber.
shots.board: atoms clicking into perfect lattice at crystal edge
shots.caption: Silicon solidifies onto it, following the seed's orderly atomic pattern.

shots.action: The wide reveal: the tall ingot hangs from the puller in the hall, its size clear against the machine and a person; Grain's face is on the ingot itself.
shots.board: giant silver ingot towering beside tiny human figure
shots.caption: I've grown. One continuous crystal: an ingot.

shots.action: Match cut from the hanging ingot to the ingot lying in the saw; a wire slices thin discs.
shots.board: wire slicing sideways ingot into thin discs
shots.caption: The ingot is sliced into thin discs.

shots.action: Follow one disc through a short montage: edge ground, polished, cleaned; one broad painted reflection; Grain looks into it, pleased.
shots.board: thin disc polishing until it mirrors the room
shots.caption: Their surfaces are carefully finished, polished, and cleaned.

shots.action: The blank wafer enters a protective carrier with others.
shots.board: mirror wafer sliding into sealed box of 25
shots.caption: Am I a chip now? You're a wafer, the foundation for many chips.

shots.action: Lou guides the closed carrier into a calm, orderly, blue-green clean room.
shots.board: box on overhead rail arriving as robot stamps it
shots.caption: Welcome to the fab. Precious cargo coming through!

shots.action: An inset enlarges a dust speck beside a delicate pattern; Lou gives the speck a stern look; the inset closes.
shots.board: box gliding into teal-lit fab interior with frame overlay
shots.caption: Here, tiny patterns become electronic circuits. Even a speck of dust can spoil the work.

shots.action: Grain in a deposition chamber; a magnified cross-section shows a new thin film forming across the wafer's surface.
shots.board: mist filming over close-up wafer
shots.caption: Thin films of material are added to the wafer.

shots.action: The same cross-section: a distinct coating covers the film.
shots.board: yellow room flashing pattern onto wafer with light
shots.caption: A light-sensitive coating goes on top.

shots.action: Light through a patterned mask changes parts of the coating; then the developer opens those areas, as two clear steps.
shots.board: plasma carving trenches then beam dosing atoms
shots.caption: Light transfers a pattern. Developing opens selected areas in the coating.

shots.action: The same cross-section: material disappears only under the openings.
shots.board: water washing wafer then scanner marking green tick
shots.caption: Etching removes material through those openings.

shots.action: A separate magnified view: a controlled, local addition of atoms; Grain watches with interest.
shots.board: wafer whirling fast through film to check again
shots.caption: Selected atoms can also be added to change silicon's electrical behaviour.

shots.action: Lou does three short actions, one per word, inspects the result and gives a small nod.
shots.board: wafer growing tall with stacked city floors and counter
shots.caption: Clean. Measure. Check.

shots.action: The operations again with visible changes building up layer on layer.
shots.board: tower of layers climbing higher in time-lapse
shots.caption: And again? Many times. Each pattern has a job.

shots.action: The montage resolves into a clear simplified circuit; Grain, satisfied, earns its red coach headband.
shots.board: finished wafer-city with many floors complete
shots.caption: Together, these steps form transistors and the connections between them.

shots.action: A round wafer with a grid of dies; one die is highlighted; Grain points to it.
shots.board: wafer rising to show mosaic of identical dies
shots.caption: One wafer holds many individual chips, called dies.

shots.action: Into the highlighted die's magnified view; a simple demonstration of a switch turning a signal on and off.
shots.board: dive into one die revealing transistor streets
shots.caption: Inside them, transistors control electrical signals: tiny switches working together.

shots.action: A hold before contact; fine probes meet the die's contact points, never its body.
shots.board: needle bed lowering onto die from above
shots.caption: Electrical probes test the dies while they're still on the wafer.

shots.action: A wafer map records results; Grain waits, gets its green mark, lets out its breath; failing dies stay on the wafer, marked.
shots.board: dies flashing green pass and one red fail with dot
shots.caption: Did I pass? You passed.

shots.action: Overhead view following a cutting lane between the dies.
shots.board: wafer flipping and grinding thinner
shots.caption: The wafer is cut along the spaces between the dies.

shots.action: Closer: one selected die, Grain's, is lifted out.
shots.board: laser cutting grid that breaks into separate dies
shots.caption: A little room of my own.

shots.action: Warm cream and muted gold: the die is seated on its substrate, its connections made.
shots.board: die landing on green square with gold wires arcing
shots.caption: A package protects the delicate die and provides electrical connections.

shots.action: The protective housing closes; Grain's eyes keep their shape on the package.
shots.board: black lid closing over wired die
shots.caption: So I can join in.

shots.action: The packaged chip is installed on a circuit board.
shots.board: chips sweeping into three bins by speed
shots.caption: After final testing, the chip is ready to become part of a device.

shots.action: Back to the beach: the phone wakes in someone's hand; the opening head tilt echoed by a tiny on-screen character; the sea and the last phrase breathe.
shots.board: chip flying into phone waking up on beach
shots.caption: From quartz, to crystal, to wafer, to chip. Small beginnings. Quite a journey.
